stateDefinitions.RESOLVED_SYNCED: The contradiction/gap has a concrete branch implementation, is based on the recorded latest-main synchronization baseline, and has CI coverage. A newer main must still be rechecked before merge/generation.
stateDefinitions.MATERIALIZED_PLANNED_NOT_AUTHORED: A first-class deterministic row/ID exists, but the actual editable/vector/image Master is not authored/approved yet.
stateDefinitions.SOURCE_DERIVED_INVENTORY_IMPLEMENTED: Membership/rows are derived from source DB arrays so additions/removals automatically change inventory; generation remains blocked.
stateDefinitions.POLICY_IMPLEMENTED_NOT_CONTENT_ADMITTED: A safe future admission model exists; concrete content remains OPEN or not yet admitted.
stateDefinitions.REUSE_AUDIT_IMPLEMENTED: Existing assets are classified for reuse/review rather than blindly regenerated.
stateDefinitions.LIVE_ADAPTER_IMPLEMENTED: Production composition is a live child of the current Character Reference Production Entrypoint rather than a stale static prompt snapshot or hard-coded wrapper path.
stateDefinitions.NON_RASTER_MIGRATION_IMPLEMENTED: Stable planning rows are preserved for traceability but current execution reinterprets them as data/HTML/CSS/SVG/read-model composition rather than independent raster generation.
stateDefinitions.COLLISION_REVIEW_IMPLEMENTED_CONTENT_UNR: Exact collision membership and non-auto-collapse rules are deterministic, but physical lineage remains unresolved until explicit authority is available.
stateDefinitions.OPEN_AUTHORITY_DEPENDENT: Count/content cannot be safely fixed yet without upstream Story/visual/human authority.
